zh.title: 上下文不是全塞进窗口
zh.lead: 先读摘要和引用，再沿 Thread、Ticket 找到报告；需要时才读取全文。
zh.diagramLabel: 可逐层读取的上下文引用图，窄屏可横向滚动
zh.caption: 每次读取都会带回下一跳引用；相关 PR 是 Ticket 的另一个分支。
zh.relatedHint: 先读取 Ticket，再访问它列出的其他 Thread。
zh.packetHint: 虚构、精简对象 · 全文按钮追加 full_text 便于教学，并非原始 API 响应。
zh.full0: 用户在飞书问：之前那个登录修复为什么还没合并？这条消息携带所属 Thread 的引用。
zh.full1: 这个聊天话题关联 Ticket demo-login。读取 Thread 可以发现其订阅 Ticket；它本身不包含所有 Worker 的全文。
zh.full2: Ticket 的执行报告说修复已就绪，但关联 PR 的测试仍失败。Ticket 暴露报告读取路径及其他 Thread 引用。
zh.full3: 报告全文：已调整重试策略并新增回归测试。最后一次 CI 在登录用例失败，需要读取关联 PR 的最新反馈。
zh.full4: 关联 PR 话题：reviewer 要求修复测试用例后再评审。这里只演示沿引用取回证据，不保证模型一定找到所有相关信息。
zh.step0Explanation: Trigger 卡片内联摘要、Thread 和 read 路径；窗口无需一开始就装入全文。
zh.step1Explanation: Thread 卡片包含订阅的 Ticket ID。读取对象后，新的引用进入上下文，成为下一跳。
zh.step2Explanation: Ticket 详情同时给出报告、执行记录和相关 Thread。可继续读报告，也可以直接跳到关联 PR。
zh.step3Explanation: 报告列表先返回摘要与全文路径。模型需要更多证据时才分页读取，减少反复塞入完整历史。
zh.step4Title: 沿 Ticket 的另一条引用补齐上下文
zh.step4Explanation: 这一步从 Ticket 指向关联 PR Thread，并非从报告自动推导关系。引用必须被系统记录，模型也必须选择读取。
zh.limit0: 图中的对象和 ID 都是虚构，字段与读取关系参照 cards.ts 和 resources.ts。
zh.limit1: 这里的 Spill 表示全文保留在窗口外，通过引用按需读取；并非每个对象都被写成独立文件。
zh.limit2: 引用图不能自动解决所有长期记忆问题；缺失关系、旧摘要和错误的读取选择仍会影响结果。

en.simulation: Teaching simulation · No real agent or API execution
en.codeNote: Source excerpts or implementation summaries omit surrounding details. Demo data is fictional.
en.fallback: Enable JavaScript to explore each step. The static diagram, explanation, and sources work without it.
en.title: Context grows along references
en.lead: Read previews and references first. Follow a Thread and Ticket to a report, and fetch full text only when needed.
en.diagramLabel: An explorable context reference graph; scroll horizontally on narrow screens
en.caption: Each read exposes next-hop references. A related PR is another branch from the Ticket.
en.relatedHint: Read the Ticket first to discover its other Threads.
en.packetHint: Fictional, trimmed objects · The full-text button appends full_text for teaching, not a raw API response.
en.full0: A user asks in chat: why is the login fix still unmerged? The message carries its Thread reference.
en.full1: This chat Thread links to Ticket demo-login. Reading the Thread discovers its subscribed Tickets, without inlining every Worker transcript.
en.full2: The Ticket report says the fix is ready, but tests still fail on the related PR. The Ticket exposes a report read path and references to other Threads.
en.full3: Full report: retry policy updated and regression tests added. The latest CI failed in a login case; read the related PR for the current feedback.
en.full4: Related PR Thread: a reviewer asks for the failing test to be fixed before review. This illustrates linked retrieval, not a guarantee that the model finds every relevant fact.
en.step0Explanation: A Trigger card inlines a preview, Thread, and read path. The context window need not start with the full body.
en.step1Title: Read the Thread to discover Tickets
en.step1Explanation: The Thread card lists subscribed Ticket IDs. Reading it brings new references into context for the next hop.
en.step2Explanation: Ticket details expose reports, transcripts, and related Threads. Read the report next or branch directly to the related PR.
en.step3Title: Retrieve the report by its read path
en.step3Explanation: Report entries return a preview and a full-text resource. The model pages in more evidence only when needed.
en.step4Explanation: This branch comes from the Ticket to its related PR Thread. It is not inferred from report text: the relation must exist and the model must choose to read it.
en.limit0: Objects and IDs are fictional; fields and read relations follow cards.ts and resources.ts.
en.limit1: Spill here means keeping full content outside the context window for on-demand reading, not writing every object to a separate file.
en.limit2: References do not solve all long-term memory problems. Missing relations, stale summaries, and poor retrieval choices still matter.
